in_sanskrit.name: चारुलेखा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Charu means beautiful, and Lekha means writing. So Charulekha means beautiful writing.

in_hindi.name: चारुलेखा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Chāru means beautiful, lekhā means writing. So Charulekha means one who has beautiful writing.

in_tamil.name: சாருலேகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Chāru means beautiful, lekha means writing. So Charulekha means beautiful writer.

in_telugu.name: చారుళేఖ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Chāru means beautiful, lekhā means writing. So Charulekha means beautiful writer.

in_marathi.name: Charulekha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charulekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Charulekha comes from the Sanskrit language, derived from the words 'Charu' meaning moon and 'Lekha' meaning mark. This name represents the idea of a divine mark bestowed upon an individual by the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with knowledge, creativity, and the feminine principle. Charulekha is a name that embodies the power and grace of the lunar deity.
